hook: Har department ka [[boss]] nikalo ek query mein

slides.title: Interview ka [[classic]]
points: Sab ek hi pattern: **Top N per group**
slides.note: Ye sawaal **har data interview** mein aata hai, pakka 💯

slides.title: Full [[query]]
slides.code:
WITH r AS (
 SELECT name, dept, salary,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
   PARTITION BY dept
   ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rn
 FROM employees)
SELECT name, dept, salary
FROM r WHERE rn = 1;
slides.note: **WITH r AS (...)** = CTE, ek temporary naam wali table 📦

slides.title: Tie [[aaye]] to?
slides.note: Same salary wale dono chahiye? **ROW_NUMBER → DENSE_RANK** swap karo

slides.wrong:
SELECT name FROM employees
WHERE ROW_NUMBER() OVER
 (PARTITION BY dept
  ORDER BY salary DESC) = 1;
slides.right:
-- CTE/subquery mein rn banao
-- bahar: WHERE rn = 1
slides.why: Window WHERE ke **baad** chalta hai → error. Pehle CTE, phir filter ✓
